name: Progress MS-17
about: Progress MS-17 (2021-057A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2021 Jun 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Jun 30), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
